_about: Public-domain Joseph Rickaby (1845-1932, Jesuit, Stonyhurst philosophy manualist) for the Word Hoard: Moral Philosophy (1888), Political and Moral Essays (1902), the Oxford and Cambridge Conferences, Notes on St. Paul (1898), Free Will and Four English Philosophers (1906), Scholasticism (1908), Waters that Go Softly, The Lord My Light, the Index to Newman's works (1914), Studies on God and His Creatures (1924) and An Old Man's Jottings (1925), from Internet Archive scans. His Aquinas translations belong to the Aquinas thread and are not on this shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jrickaby-moral-philosophy: Moral Philosophy, or Ethics and Natural Law (London: Longmans, Green, 1888)
jrickaby-notes-st-paul: Notes on St. Paul: Corinthians, Galatians, Romans (London: Burns and Oates, 1898)
jrickaby-oxford-cambridge-conferences: Oxford & Cambridge Conferences, 1897-1899 (London: Burns and Oates; year garbled, catalogued 1899)
jrickaby-political-moral-essays: Political and Moral Essays (New York, Cincinnati, Chicago: Benziger Brothers, 1902)
jrickaby-free-will: Free Will and Four English Philosophers (London: Burns and Oates, 1906)
jrickaby-waters-go-softly: Waters that Go Softly, or Thoughts for Time of Retreat (London: Burns and Oates, 1912)
jrickaby-index-newman: Index to the Works of John Henry Cardinal Newman (London: Longmans, Green, 1914)
jrickaby-lord-my-light: The Lord My Light (London: Burns & Oates; title page undated, imprimatur 1915)
jrickaby-studies-god-creatures: Studies on God and His Creatures (London: Longmans, Green, 1924)
jrickaby-old-mans-jottings: An Old Man's Jottings (London: Longmans, Green, 1925)

_alternates.jrickaby-aquinas: Aquinas Ethicus (1892, 1896) and Of God and His Creatures (1905): his translations of Aquinas, left to the Aquinas thread
_alternates.jrickaby-copies: The 1889 second edition of Moral Philosophy and PG 8103 (a later edition, source not stated); the Second Series of Conferences (1902)

_excluded.jrickaby-john: First Principles of Knowledge and General Metaphysics: by his brother John Rickaby
_excluded.jrickaby-others: Plays and ballads by other Rickabys
